# Angular adapter — banned APIs. Format: <extended regex><TAB><use instead>.
# validate-adapters.sh greps every .md here; a hit is allowed only on a line saying why (removed / deprecated / instead / never use / do not use / not supported).
# Core
afterRender\(	afterNextRender( / afterRenderEffect( / afterEveryRender( (afterRender removed)
ChangeDetectionStrategy\.Default	ChangeDetectionStrategy.Eager (renamed in v22; OnPush is the default)
standalone: *true	omit it — standalone is the default
@HostBinding|@HostListener	host: {} metadata
\*ngIf|\*ngFor|\*ngSwitch	@if / @for / @switch
import \{[^}]*\bRoutes\b[^}]*\} from ["']@angular/core	import { Routes } from "@angular/router"
# Animations (@angular/animations deprecated since 20.2, removal planned in v23)
@angular/animations	animate.enter / animate.leave + native CSS
provideAnimations(Async)?\(	remove — native CSS animations need no provider
\[@[A-Za-z]+\]	animate.enter / animate.leave, [class.x] + CSS transitions
# Signal Forms
(hidden|disabled|readonly)\([A-Za-z_.]+, *\(	{ when: (ctx) => … } config object (positional logic fn deprecated)
# HTTP / DI
HTTP_INTERCEPTORS	functional HttpInterceptorFn + provideHttpClient(withInterceptors([...]))
@Injectable\(\{ *providedIn: *["']root["'] *\}\)	@Service()
# State
@ngrx/store	@ngrx/signals signalStore
# SSR
prerender: *true	ServerRoute { renderMode: RenderMode.Prerender } in app.routes.server.ts
# Testing (zoneless + Vitest)
fakeAsync|waitForAsync	vi.useFakeTimers() + await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(ms), await fixture.whenStable()
toBeTrue\(|toBeFalse\(	toBe(true) / toBe(false) (Jasmine matchers)
# Tooling (pnpm everywhere)
(^|[^p])npm (install|run|i) 	pnpm add / pnpm run
